narr: Strong to severe thunderstorms moved into northwestern Arkansas during the morning of the 28th. These storms produced widespread heavy rainfall that resulted in flash flooding, as well as damaging wind gusts. Another round of thunderstorms developed across northwestern Arkansas during the evening of the 28th, as a cold front moved into the area. The strongest storms produced large hail up to golf ball size and damaging wind.||Widespread heavy rainfall of four to six inches, with isolated amounts to eight inches, resulted in significant rises on rivers in northwestern Arkansas. Major flooding occurred along the Arkansas River.

Widespread flooding was reported across the northern half of Franklin County, with a couple of bridges washed out. Several water rescues also occurred.
Several residents of an apartment complex in Alma were trapped by flood water, and had to be rescued. Numerous roads were flooded across the county.
